# Project Atlas — Charter

Atlas is the internal effort to replace the legacy billing pipeline. It began in
March and is scheduled to run for three quarters. The steering group meets every
other Tuesday.

## Scope

The project covers invoice generation, payment reconciliation, and the customer
statement mailer. Explicitly out of scope: the tax engine, which stays on the
existing platform until a separate migration is funded.

## Budget

The approved figure is four million dollars, allocated across engineering,
infrastructure, and a contingency reserve of roughly twelve percent. Spend to
date sits under plan, mostly because the infrastructure migration slipped a
quarter.

## Staffing

Priya Raman leads the project and reports to the VP of Platform. Two teams are
seconded from Payments and one from Data Platform. Contract support was approved
for the reconciliation workstream only.
